Service Name

Std_ReturnType EthIf_SwtEthTxFinishedIndication (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx
)
Service ID [hex]
0xb6
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different CtrlIdxs. Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx.
CtrlIdx
Ethernet Controller index
Parameters (in)
BufIdx
Ethernet Rx Buffer index
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Frame successfully processed
E_NOT_OK: Frame processing failed
Description
Indication for a finished transmit process for a specific Ethernet frame.
Available via
EthIf.h
